headline: A capital V, a job number, and a layout fix.
notes: Choose a capital V for new versions: Settings › Buttons › Version up › Click › Case gives Brand Film_V01 instead of Brand Film_v01. A name that already has a version keeps its own case, so Cut_v03 still becomes Cut_v04

Add a job number to your names: fill in Job no. in Project setup (under Project) and use the new job chip in Custom, Custom name, Your own suffix and Project file names. It is saved with each project, like Client and Project
Fixed: the plugin could open as three small buttons with empty space below in a tall dock. It now uses the full layout whenever there is room for it
